tei:div.tei:p: (513)ser sngo bsod nams mchog ster dpa' mo gcig tu sgrub pa'i rgyun gyi rnor tshe dang bsod nams spel ba'i phrin las bzhugs so/ (514)

rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las ma/ chos rnams kun gyi dbyings chen po/ 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ las kyi bya ba'i cho ga rnams sgrub khog las shes par byas te/ phrin las kyi 'jug pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ oṃ/ deng nas bla med byang chub bar/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso/ rnam bzhi 'phags pa bskyed pa'i yum/ rje btsun 'phags ma sras bcas la/ 'gro ba kun la phan slad du/ yang dag nyid du skyabs su mchi/ gnyis pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ āḥ skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal gyi/ srid pa'i chu bor 'khyams pa rnams/ rang bzhin skye ba med pa'i dbyings/ sangs rgyas (515)sa la 'god par bya/ gsum pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ oṃ/ sras bcas 'phags ma'i spyan snga ru/ sgo gsum dngas bas phyag 'tshal lo/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung 'bul/ thogs med nyes byas mthol lo bshags/ byang chub spyod la rjes yi rang*/ zag med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ 'gro mgon mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ yang dag sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi chos dbyings de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ/ sems nyid rang bzhin skye ba med/ rnam par mi rtog rtog las 'das/ chos rnams mnyam pa chen po'i dbyings/ de bzhin (516)nyid kyi ting 'dzin sgom/ oṃ dharmā rdartu bi shud+dhe hūm̐/ snying rje sgyu ma ni/ āḥ skye ba rnam bzhis bsdus pa yi/ ma rtog log rtog sems can rnams/ rang snang 'khrul pas rang bcings pa/ sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā sa ma yi āḥ rgyu yi ting nga 'dzin ni/ hūm̐/ skye med ngang las snying rje'i gdangs/ 'gag med cing yang 'char ba las/ rang byung rig pa yi ge tām̐/ gser zhun lugs pa blugs pa bzhin/ sra zhing 'thas la mi shigs pa/ mi phyed rdo rje'i chos bdun bsgom/

dzñā na badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ti āḥ de las dbyings kyi yi ge lnga/ mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin/ 'phros pas snod bcud zhen rtog sbyangs/ yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag oṃ (517)eḥyaṃ laṃ saṃ raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ dharmā dhartu sa man+ta pash+tsa k+ṣa bu thā na/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā maṇ+ḍal bi shud+dhe saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ḥ bh+rūm̐ las 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sprul pa'i zhing khams po ta la/ sna tshogs nor bu'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs/ 'dod snam pha gu rin chen phreng*/ mda' yab shar bu mdzes pa'i tog sgo rgyan rgyu 'bras rta bab ldan/ drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan brgyan/ 'dod yon mchod sprin bsam mi khyab/ nang khyams gru chad glo 'bur bcas/ lte bar pad+ma zla ba'i gdan/ sam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+t+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ rang bzhin rtsa ba'i yi ge tām̐/ dbus kyi gdan (517)gyi steng du babs/ gser zhun lta bu'i tām̐ yig las/ ut+pal tam̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ srid pa dag ni thams cad du/ sna tshogs 'od dang zer gyis khengs/ sprul pa sgyu ma 'ja' tshon dang*/ smig rgyu chu zla gzugs brnyan bzhin/ 'dzig rten bdun po snang byas nas/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos so cog ye nas dag mnyam chen po'i ngang*/ snod bcud lha yi rol par shar/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen rigs las skyes pa yi/ brtson 'grus shugs dang ldan pa'i yum/ sgrol ma bsod nams mchog ster ma/ jaṃ bu na da'i kha dog la/ ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa ltar/ dag cing gtsang la dri ma med/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab/ zhi (519)zhing 'jum pa'i mdangs dang ldan/ thugs rjes su chags pa yi/ smin legs spyan ni rnam par 'khyug ka sha'i ras kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ pañtsa'i gos kyis smad dkris shing*/ rin chen thogs tshur do shal dang*/ rna cha gdub gor 'og par dang*/ sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes par byas/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan 'chang*/

phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya mdzad/ g.yon pa dkon mchog gsum mtshon rgyas/ sdong bu dang bcas ut+pa la/ rin chen bum pas mtshan pa bsnams/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng*/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ de yi dbu gtsug 'od lnga'i klong*/ srong btsan rgam po spyan ras gzigs/ (520)dkar gsal chu shel dngas ba'i mdog lha bu mdzes pa'i cha byad can/ g.yas pas shel gyi mkhar ba'i rtser/ pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa la/ bskal ba sangs rgyas stong rtsa bzhugs/ g.yon pa skyabs sbyin phyag rgya yis/ phrin las don kun grub mdzad pa/ nor bu'i phreng ba thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yas su lha cig go 'jo ma/ sgrol ma yum dang gnyis su med/ g.yon du bal mo khri btsun ma/ khro gnyer can dang gnyis su med/ bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od kyi tshogs/ sku las 'phros pa de nyid las/ ut+pal ser po ge sar bcas/ bdud rtsi'i zeg ma 'phro ba las/ 'byung po'i stobs rnams zil gnon pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dpag bsam dang*/ rnam 'phrul sgrol ma nyi shu 'phro/ phyi (521)rol zhing gi bkod pa ni/ pad+ma drwa ba can gyi zhing*/ sna tshogs khams kyis rnal 'byor spras/ sgrib pa mi mnga' mngon sum du/ rin chen lnga yis rab mdzes pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan byug pa yis/ mtsho dang mtsho phran rdzing bu'i tshogs/ nor bu sna tshogs bye bas gtams/ mdzes pa'i me tog kun nas bskor/ dga' zhing 'phro la lding ba'i bya/ snyan pa'i skad 'byin chos sgra sgrogs/ rin chen gling na lhun po dang*/ dag pa'i zhing na dag pa'i rdzas/ pi waṃ gling bu rdza rnga dang*/ sil snyan glu gar bstod dbyangs kyi/ lha dang lha mo bsam mi khyab/ ta la dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal/ dar dang rin chen 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ me tog 'brus rnam par smin/ phyogs bzhir dar (522)gyi ba dan las/ bdug spos dri zhim rgyas par 'gengs/ nam mkhar rat+na sna tshogs kyis/

sprin tshogs stug po las skyes pa'i/ spos chu me tog 'dres pa dang*/ 'dod yon sna tshogs char chen 'bebs/ gser gyi brag skyib brag ri'i khrod/ spang ljongs me tog brgyan pa'i tshal/ smin pa'i glang chen stong dag dang*/ rta mchog yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ri dgas tshogs ni dal gyi rgyu/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin bye ba brgya/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po dang*/ rig sngags rgyal mo stong phrag gis/ rtag tu zhi ba brten pa'i gnas/ snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen por sad/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying gi hūm̐ dang tām̐ yig las (523)'od zer ser po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyi thugs dam bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par bzhengs nas/ dam tshig pa rnams la sib kyis thim par bsam/ oṃ/ skyob pa 'od dpag med pa yi/ thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ smon lam stobs las 'khrungs ba'i sku/ sgrol ma'i mtshan gyi rnga chen po/ zhing rnams kun tu rab grags ma/ rje btsun sgrol lam 'khor dang bcas/ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'byon par 'tshal/ nyon mongs dri ma bsal ba dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sel byed cing*/ semam can rnams la phan slad du/ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs (524)su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya ta re sa pā ri wā ra e h+ya hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ/ nyi ma zla ba rgyas 'dra ba'i/ gzhon nu'i sku la 'gying bag can/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ ut+pal sngon po'i ge sar la/ nya gang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ dgyes mnyam mchog thugs ldan pas/

gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol/ pad+ma tsan+d+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ las dang nyon mongs stobs rnams dang*/ bdud kyi sde rnams pham mdzad ma/ skyob pa skyabs 'os bde ba byin/ shes bcu rnam dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ dbyangs can lha mo spyan yangs ma/ shes rab glo 'phel snyan pa che/ g.yul (525)las sgrol byed rgyal ba mo/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tī ts+tsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ/ 'jin khams ni rab 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlabs shing*/ me tog bdug spos mar me dang*/ dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i tshogs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re puṣ+pe dhup+pe a lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+ta pu tsa mo gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ḥ 'dod yon lngas mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs shing*/ ye shes lnga yi ngo (526)bo nyid/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med kyis/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra pa spar+she pū ja pra ti ts+tsha ho/ de nas bstod pa ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya te tre ya te ta re tu ro oṃḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rdzogs/ mnyam nyid ye shes ngang la gnas/ tshogs chen bsod nams chogs ster ma/ rin chen yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ljang mdzes sprin gyi gur gsob na/ sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma'i spyan/ gzhon nu mtshan dang dpe brgyad 'bar/ sgrol ma yum la/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus/ khro bo'i tshogs chen spro (527)zhing sdud/ brkyangs bskum stabs kyis gdug pa 'dul/

khro gnyer can la/ oṃ/ 'jig rten gsum na grags pa yi/ 'byung po gang dag ji snyed pas/ zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud cing*/ 'jig rten gsum mgon khyod la/ sems can kun la phan bzhed ma/ dbang phyug lha dang lha min dang*/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ bkur 'os mchod 'os khyed la/ ut+pal sngon po'i zur mig gis/ rtag tu 'gro ba skyong mdzad pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras bcas kyis/ sgrol ma'i mtshan gyis bsngags la bstod/ gang zhig mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*/ de yi don kun 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ nyon mongs kun las rnam grol ba/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob par 'gyur/ de nas (528) bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ āḥ thugs kar pad+ma zla ba'i steng*/ rang byung rig pa yi ge tām̐/ de mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ 'od 'phros las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub/ ces dang*/ rje btsun ma'i thugs kar ut+pal dang zla ba'i dal gyi ste+ong rig pa sa yi ge tām̐ ser po'i mthar rtsa ba'i sngags dang bstod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud gser zhun ma'i kha dog lta bu'i chos bskor du 'khor ba dang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsir ser po'i rgyun dang*/ ut+pal ser po'i ze'u 'bru las byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma rnam 'phrul nyi shu gzhan gyi stobs zil gyis gnon pa mong nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu 'phros pas/ lha dang lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dri za lto 'phyo srin po'i tshogs gang su yang rung ba rnams kyi stobs (529)dang sde rnams tshar bcad snang la rang bzhin med par sbyangs/ slar 'jig rten gsum po thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku dang gsung sngags kyi sgra dbyangs/ thugs ut+pal tām̐ḥser pos mtshan pa sha stag tu gyur nas bdag nyid la thim pas/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dang yon tan thams cad gong 'phel du gyur/ oṃ/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma phyag 'tshal lo/ sogs bstod pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal nyer gcigi nus par bstod nas/

de'i rjes su/ oṃ tā re tā re tut+ta re swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa bsnyen pa'o/ nye bsnyen rgyas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tā re tut+ta re hūm̐ ka ra pu re na te pañtsa ri sab+ta lo ka kra ma kro ti a she ṣa sur+ṇaṃ ku ru kar shan k+ṣa mi hoḥ ces dang*/ las myur du 'grub pa'i sngags/ oṃ oṃ tā re oṃ/ oṃ ta re oṃ/ oṃ tut+ta re oṃ/ zhes zla'o/ de nas 'jam dpal (530) gyi thugs dam sgrol ma'i gzungs ni/ ag khe/ bag khe/ na ji te/ nā gā sa te/ na hi li/ ja hi li/ ja hi li ba ti/ tsa ṭi la ba te swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla'o/ phan yon ni/ 'byung po'i tshogs ni mthugs kyi/ de yi stobs thub mi 'gyur bas/ srung dang skyobs dang sbed par byed/ dus min 'chi dang rmi lam na/ rim dang dug gi mi tshugs la/ yo byad che dang dran stobs ldan/ rtag tu sangs rgyas mthong ba dang*/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ zhes so/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba mchod bstod byas te/ bsdu ldang ni/ snang srid lha yi 'khor lo kun/ dmigs med yum gyi ngang du thim/ stong nyid bdag med rang rig pas/ dmigs bya dmigs med dran dbang bsgyur/ slar yang sprul pa sgyu ma'i tshul/ sku gsung thugs yon zhing khams las/ gzhan du ma dmigs de nyid yin/ rtsa sngags kyi rjes kyi ltar ldang ngo*/ bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bla med theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ rim (531)(532)pa gnyis kyi lam sbyangs bas/ nyon mongs las rnams kun byang te/ 'phags ma'i go 'phang thob par shog shes pa brjod pa ni/ stobs bcu dbang phyug rigs lnga yum/ rdo rje btsun mo bde ba che/ ye shes lnga ldan rje btsun mas/ rtag tu skyong ba'i bkra shis shog zhes pa 'di'ang rang la mos pa'i blo gzhan gyi mi 'phrog pa gzer bsod nams kyi mos ngor rgyun khyer du bsdu pa 'di pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge'o/ phyag bris la zhus dag bya'o/// /
